i.norm: Verifies the default {@link Soundex} encoder against the worked examples published in the "American Soundex" section of the Wikipedia article on Soundex (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soundex#American_Soundex, as of 2015-03-22).

Each input name is encoded with the default US-English Soundex and compared to the four-character code listed in the Wikipedia examples. The chosen names exercise notable rules of the algorithm:
  • {@code Robert} / {@code Rupert} - different names that share the same code.
  • {@code Ashcraft} / {@code Ashcroft} - adjacent letters mapping to the same digit are collapsed.
  • {@code Tymczak} - H and W (here the silent letters) are skipped without separating duplicate codes.
  • {@code Pfister} - the leading consonant cluster keeps only the first letter.
